Redis hashes

Redis hashes are record types structured as collections of field-value pairs. You can use hashes to represent basic objects and to store groupings of counters, among other things.

See lists, HSET and the hash table article, or elsewhere.

Basic commands

  • HSET sets the value of one or more fields on a hash.
  • HGET returns the value at a given field.
> HSET bike:1 model Deimos
(integer) 1

Performance

Most hash commands are O(1). A few commands, such as HKEYS, HVALS and HGETALL, are O(n), where n is the number of field-value pairs.
